connector.name: Minerva MCP - Microsoft 365 & Azure
connector.registryDescription: Microsoft 365 & Azure admin: Graph, ARM, and the PowerShell cmdlets Graph does not expose.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package minerva-mcp. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the houssemmak account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
env.description: Entra tenant id. Only needed for unattended app-only sign-in; omit it to sign in interactively with a device code.

env.name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Application (client) id. Defaults to the public Microsoft Graph PowerShell client, so it is optional for trying the server out.

env.name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Client secret for app-only authentication. Leave unset to sign in interactively instead.

env.name: MINERVA_SHAREPOINT_URL
env.description: SharePoint root URL, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com. Required only by the SharePoint/PnP tool when PowerShell runs locally.
